name: Milcah (Nahor's wife, Haran's daughter)
title: Matriarch in Abraham's lineage
summary: Milcah was the daughter of Haran and married her uncle Nahor, Abraham's brother. She became a matriarch of an important branch of the patriarchs' family, and her granddaughter Rebekah later became Isaac's wife. Through her, the family ties between Abraham's line and his brother's line were preserved.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Nahor's wife
keyEvents.description: Milcah is first mentioned as the daughter of Haran and the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother. This establishes the important family relationships in Terah's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Her Family Leaves Ur
keyEvents.description: Milcah was part of the family when Terah took Abraham, Lot, and their wives and left Ur of the Chaldeans to go toward Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Eight Sons
keyEvents.description: Milcah bore eight sons to Nahor, including Bethuel who became the father of Rebekah and Laban. This made her a matriarch for an important part of the patriarchs' lineage.

keyEvents.title: Grandmother of Rebekah
keyEvents.description: Through her son Bethuel, Milcah became the grandmother of Rebekah, who was chosen to become Isaac's wife. This linked Abraham's line back to his brother's family.
